get.description: Get translation providers. The LLM provider is also used by document extraction and enrichment jobs.

put.description: Update translation providers. The LLM provider settings apply to document extraction and enrichment jobs as well as translation.

409.description: Source sync is already running elsewhere

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code for programmatic handling.

has_more.description:
`true` when the service observed at least one extra candidate beyond
`offset + limit`; `false` when the probed window was exhausted.
When absent, the service could not safely probe (for example the fixed
candidate window hit its cap), so callers must not infer end-of-results.

total.description:
Known result count for the current window. For search windows with
`total_is_exact=false`, this is a lower bound, not an exact match count.

total_is_exact.description:
`false` means `total` and `total_pages` are lower bounds over the
currently known candidate window, not exact database counts.
When absent, preserves the legacy exact-total semantics for existing
paginated endpoints.

total_pages.description:
Page count derived from `total`. For search windows with
`total_is_exact=false`, this is also a lower bound.

dry_run.description:
When true, only read eligibility counts and return a preview without
mutating any row or writing any audit row. Optional for backward
compatibility; omitted or false preserves the mutating behavior.

grace_minutes.description:
Only rows older than this many minutes are eligible. Defaults to 30,
must be between 10 and 10080 (one week).

limit.description:
Maximum rows to quarantine per call. Defaults to 100, clamped to
1..=1000.

reason.description: Free-form human justification stored on each row and its audit row.

dry_run.description:
True when this response is a dry-run preview: no row was mutated and
no audit row was written. Always present; false for mutating calls so
callers never conflate eligible rows with changed rows.

quarantinable_count.description:
Total eligible (`quarantinable`) `submitting` rows at read time:
placeholder remote id, older than the grace cutoff, terminal parents.
Uncapped by `limit`. In dry-run mode this is the full preview total
with `quarantined` empty and `quarantined_count` zero. In mutating
mode this is the remainder still eligible after this call, while
`quarantined_count` is the actual number of rows changed.

skipped_fresh.description: Still `submitting` because it is newer than the grace cutoff.

skipped_non_terminal.description: Still `submitting` because the parent task/item is not terminal.

skipped_real_remote.description:
Still `submitting` with a non-placeholder remote id; needs manual
review because a real remote job may exist.

reason.description: Free-form human justification recorded in operator logs.

already_queued.description:
True when the item was already queued and no state changed: no new
attempt row and no new remote job were created.

stage.description: Stage the item was parked on for dispatcher pickup (`docling`).

reason.description: Free-form human justification recorded in the recovery audit.

docling_max_inflight.description:
Persisted Docling remote-slot ceiling (`docling_settings.max_inflight`,
default 1 when unconfigured). Read-only capacity signal; the overview
never tunes admission.

due_docling_waiting_count.description:
Due admission-deferred `waiting/backoff` items carrying the
`remote admission is full` marker whose deferral delay has elapsed.
Read-only backpressure signal paired with `docling_max_inflight`.

oldest_quarantinable_submitting_at.description:
Oldest `submitted_at` among quarantinable `submitting` rows (same
eligibility as `quarantinable_submitting`). `None` when empty.
Read-only age signal.

oldest_uncertain_submitting_at.description:
Oldest `submitted_at` among uncertain `submitting` Docling rows.
`None` when no such row exists. Read-only age signal.

orphaned_external_jobs.description:
Rows already isolated as `orphaned`: non-active, no longer blocking
terminal-task cleanup/purge or Docling admission.

quarantinable_submitting.description:
Stale placeholder `submitting` rows on terminal parents that the admin
quarantine API is allowed to isolate as `orphaned`.

uncertain_submitting.description:
Uncertain `submitting` Docling rows (all ages, terminal parents or not).
These rows never count as remotely cancelled and need explicit review.

oneOf.description: Re-process existing library files that already have a file id.
Ingest file contents uploaded inline as base64.
